summary.why: The student's receipt can only be carried by a relay that can address an arbitrary recipient. The owner's own Apps Script relay (the only verified-sender path) is LIVE and reports configured:true (server token minted), but the CLIENT token (mail.appsScript.token) is empty, so every doPost() answers 'Not authorised.' and the receipt falls back to Web3Forms (unverifiable from this datacenter) and EmailJS (unconfigured).

root_cause.title: Student confirmation relay has no working route: Apps Script client-token unwired + stranger-capable fallbacks unavailable/unverifiable
chain_of_truth: Booking submit resolves the student recipient from the validated #bk-email field (js/features.js sendRequest).
The booking record is committed to the ledger BEFORE any send, with the student email persisted (store.js add()).
mailer.js send() builds three separate messages: tutorBody() -> tutor target, siteBody() -> EkGuru inbox, studentBody() -> the student's own address.
The student job picks the first stranger-capable, sendable provider: Apps Script, then Web3Forms, then EmailJS.

Apps Script: URL set (v3) + server token minted (configured:true) BUT client token empty -> sendable()=false after v99, so it is no longer picked at all (and, before v99, it was picked and refused with 'Not authorised.' every time).
Web3Forms: 5 keys configured (1 legacy + 4), 250/month each, but the endpoint is datacenter-blocked here and key validity cannot be confirmed from this sandbox.
FormSubmit: cannot reach an unactivated address (probed: 'This form needs Activation...') -> INCOMPATIBLE_FOR_STUDENT_PRIMARY.
StaticForms: ignores the recipient, delivers to the key-owner inbox only -> INCOMPATIBLE_FOR_STUDENT_PRIMARY.
Result: tutor copy and EkGuru record (addressed to our own activated inboxes) succeed via the free FormSubmit relay, while the student's receipt has no route -> EXHAUSTED. Exactly the reported bug.

providers.reason_not_sendable: client token (mail.appsScript.token) empty; server token IS minted (doGet -> configured:true)
providers.booking_student: PRIMARY once token wired (arbitrary recipient, replyTo, verified EkGuru sender, no activation)
providers.booking_tutor: can carry (arbitrary recipient) but tutor copies that route to our inbox use the free relay instead
providers.booking_internal: yes (addressed to us, but free relay preferred for cost)

providers.booking_student: fallback carrier (arbitrary recipient via `to`, but from_name is relay-side; cannot be verified from this datacenter)
providers.booking_internal: never used for our own inbox (ownInboxRelay prefers free)
providers.recipient_support: arbitrary (account verified by key, not recipient)
providers.error_classes: quota, invalid access key (retires the key)

providers.booking_student: INCOMPATIBLE_FOR_STUDENT_PRIMARY (ignores recipient; delivers to key-owner inbox only)
providers.booking_tutor: only as floor (message says 'FOR: <tutor>' and asks forwarding)

providers.booking_student: INCOMPATIBLE_FOR_STUDENT_PRIMARY (every new recipient must click an activation link)
providers.booking_tutor: only for our own activated inboxes
providers.contact_visitor: visitor copy rides as CC on a post to our inbox (no activation needed for CC)

BOOKING_STUDENT.recipient: studentEmail (validated, trimmed, lowercased, persisted as emailNorm)

note_delivered: DELIVERED is never set from a provider acceptance; a relay can only confirm ACCEPTED.
code_changes_v99: js/mailer.js: provider.sendable() (Apps Script needs client token), chain() uses sendable(), student direct pick uses chain(), post() returns attempts+msgId, studentBody() gains Date&time/Timezone/Lesson/Current status rows, send() returns per-role emailDelivery {status,provider,lastAttempt,lastError,retryCount,messageId,recipient}, relayHealth() API added, providers() gains sendable+tokenMissing
js/store.js: booking record persists emailDelivery + flat student_email_status/provider/last_attempt/last_error/retry_count/message_id + emailNorm

js/features.js: student recipient normalized once and reused; QUEUED state at commit; emailDelivery persisted on success and on failure (EXHAUSTED/FAILED); honest per-role status on the confirmation screen
admin.html: per-role badges show provider/last attempt/retries/error; Delivery tab gains live Apps Script relay health incl. token-wiring status

release_gate.student_mailbox: BLOCKED_ON_OWNER_STEP (must wire mail.appsScript.token; real inbox receipt then verifiable)
release_gate.tutor_recipient: PASS_STRUCTURAL (tutors with no address route to EkGuru inbox as TUTOR_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE, shown in admin)
release_gate.internal_record: PASS (FormSubmit to our activated inbox, probed success:true)
release_gate.fallback: PASS_STRUCTURAL (sequential chain, stop-on-accept, EXHAUSTED at end; exercised in email-e2e)
release_gate.idempotency: PASS_STRUCTURAL (BOOKING-{ref}-{ROLE} keys in localStorage; admin retry uses force:true)
release_gate.contact_regression: PASS_STRUCTURAL (contact flow untouched; re-verified by email-e2e test A)

remaining_owner_steps: Open the Apps Script project 1kcvADOf9OqQQ2uH3Yl4fC6aG7-fBR1asfaGpqLf9cqn_xErvkZ5TMHKm -> Project Settings -> Script Properties -> copy MAILER_SHARED_TOKEN.
Run tools/wire-token.py (or set mail.appsScript.token in js/site-config.js at deploy time) with that value, WITHOUT committing it.

Re-deploy GitHub Pages, then from a real browser submit two controlled test bookings (Student A->Tutor A, Student B->Tutor B) and confirm each student's inbox receives their own receipt (no duplicate, admin shows provider + ACCEPTED).
That real-mailbox receipt is the only thing that flips student_mailbox to PASS.
